common_app_compat_app_outdated: This interface is older than the background service and isn't compatible: you can keep reading mail, but writing, flagging and settings changes are paused. Reinstall the built-in interface from the menu bar via “Repair & Background…”, or update {product}.
common_app_compat_kernel_outdated: The background service is older than this interface and isn't compatible: you can keep reading mail, but writing, flagging and settings changes are paused. Restart the background service; if you just rolled back {product}, reinstall the built-in interface from the menu bar via “Repair & Background…”.
common_app_identity_intro: This window connects to the background service under its own identity, which the service doesn't recognize yet. It won't fall back to running with full user access.
common_app_identity_retry: Once it's installed, the connection is retried automatically; you don't need to reopen the window.
common_app_identity_title: {product} UI isn't registered as a frontend package yet
